title: Social Media Specialist
description:
درباره موقعیت شغلی
ما به دنبال یک کارشناس شبکه‌های اجتماعی خلاق، مسئولیت‌پذیر و نتیجه‌محور هستیم که بتواند مدیریت و توسعه شبکه‌های اجتماعی برند را بر عهده بگیرد و با تدوین استراتژی محتوایی مؤثر، به افزایش آگاهی از برند، جذب مخاطب هدف و رشد مستمر صفحات کمک کند.
در این موقعیت، صرفاً انتشار منظم محتوا کافی نیست؛ انتظار داریم با شناخت مخاطبان، تحلیل داده‌ها، شناسایی فرصت‌های رشد و اجرای ایده‌های خلاقانه، عملکرد شبکه‌های اجتماعی را به‌صورت مستمر بهبود دهید.
مسئولیت‌ها و وظایف
تدوین و اجرای استراتژی شبکه‌های اجتماعی متناسب با اهداف کسب‌وکار و هویت برند
طراحی، برنامه‌ریزی و مدیریت تقویم محتوایی برای شبکه‌های اجتماعی، به‌ویژه لینکدین
ایده‌پردازی، تولید و انتشار محتوای خلاقانه، هدفمند و متناسب با مخاطبان هر پلتفرم
مدیریت مستمر صفحات و حفظ انسجام لحن، پیام و هویت برند در محتواها
شناسایی و تحلیل ترندهای مرتبط، بررسی رقبا و ارائه ایده‌های جدید برای بهبود عملکرد محتوا
طراحی و اجرای برنامه‌های عملی برای افزایش تعامل، جذب مخاطبان هدف و رشد تعداد دنبال‌کنندگان
پایش شاخص‌های عملکردی شبکه‌های اجتماعی و تحلیل نتایج محتواها و کمپین‌ها
بهینه‌سازی مستمر استراتژی محتوا بر اساس داده‌ها، بازخورد مخاطبان و نتایج به‌دست‌آمده
تهیه گزارش‌های دوره‌ای از عملکرد شبکه‌های اجتماعی، روند رشد و میزان تحقق اهداف
همکاری با سایر اعضای تیم برای هماهنگی محتوا با اهداف بازاریابی و کسب‌وکار
شرایط و مهارت‌های مورد نیاز
حداقل 4 سال سابقه کاری مرتبط در مدیریت شبکه‌های اجتماعی و بازاریابی محتوا
تجربه عملی در مدیریت و توسعه صفحات شبکه‌های اجتماعی، به‌ویژه لینکدین
توانایی تدوین استراتژی محتوا و تبدیل اهداف کسب‌وکار به برنامه‌های اجرایی
مهارت در ایده‌پردازی، نگارش و تولید محتوای جذاب و متناسب با مخاطب هدف

شناخت شاخص‌های کلیدی عملکرد (KPI) مانند نرخ تعامل، نرخ رشد دنبال‌کنندگان و میزان دسترسی محتوا

آشنایی با ترندهای روز، رفتار مخاطبان و تغییرات الگوریتم‌های شبکه‌های اجتماعی
مهارت در برنامه‌ریزی، مدیریت زمان و انجام هم‌زمان چند فعالیت
توانایی ارائه گزارش‌های شفاف و تصمیم‌گیری بر اساس داده‌ها
مزیت محسوب می‌شود

title: Content Creation, Website, and Social Media Support Specialist
description:
شرکت صاف نوش ایرانیان به دنبال یک متخصص حمایت از تولید محتوا، وب‌سایت و شبکه‌های اجتماعی برای تقویت حضور و تعامل آنلاین خود در حوالی شهرقدس (منطقه 21) است. این نقش شامل خلق و انتشار محتوای جذاب و مرتبط با برند، مدیریت وب‌سایت و ارتقاء فعالیت‌های شبکه‌های اجتماعی می‌باشد.
مسئولیت ها:
- خلق و انتشار محتوای خلاقانه و هدفمند برای وب‌سایت و شبکه‌های اجتماعی
- همکاری با تیم برای توسعه و اجرای استراتژی‌های دیجیتال مارکتینگ
- نظارت بر روندها و تحولات جدید در ارتباط با شبکه‌های اجتماعی و دیجیتال مارکتینگ
- به‌روزرسانی و بهینه‌سازی مستمر صفحات وب‌سایت جهت بهبود تجربه کاربر و سئو

شایستگی ها:
- تجربه قبلی در حوزه بازاریابی دیجیتال، تولید محتوا یا مدیریت شبکه‌های اجتماعی
- آشنایی با ابزارهای مدیریت وب‌سایت و شبکه‌های اجتماعی
- مهارت در استفاده از زبان فارسی به صورت کتبی و گفتاری
- توانایی کار تیمی و داشتن مهارت‌های ارتباطی قوی
- خلاقیت و علاقه‌مند به یادگیری و به روز بودن با تحولات روز

title: Social Media Campaign Manager
description:
Social Media Campaign Manager
About the Role
Trend is looking for an experienced Social Media Campaign Manager to join and grow its team.
In this role, you will be responsible for turning client briefs into effective media plans, budget allocations, KPI frameworks, and media recommendations. You will also play an active role in analyzing campaign performance and providing data-driven recommendations to improve results.
Responsibilities
• Review and analyze client briefs, objectives, and requirements
• Develop media plans and influencer marketing scenarios based on campaign objectives and budgets
• Evaluate and select the most relevant media channels and influencers
• Prepare campaign budgets and propose different media scenarios
• Define and forecast campaign KPIs
• Analyze campaign performance and compare actual results against forecasts
• Prepare proposals, presentations, and media recommendations for clients
• Present and defend media strategies and recommendations in client meetings
Requirements
• Minimum 2–3 years of experience in Media Planning or Social Media, preferably within an advertising agency
• Strong proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets
• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with numbers and data
• Good understanding of the Iranian Digital Media and Social Media landscape
• Familiarity with key media KPIs such as Reach, Impressions, Engagement, CPM, and CPV
• Ability to prepare professional proposals and media plans
• Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to confidently defend recommendations in meetings
• High attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
• Strong analytical and commercial mindset

title: Content Marketing & Social Media Specialist
description:
استخدام کارشناس محتوا و شبکه‌های اجتماعی
حوزه فعالیت: ماشین‌آلات سنگین، معدنی، حفاری و راه‌سازی
بخش بازرگانی ماشین‌آلات سنگین شرکت ماهور همایون با بیش از 20 سال سابقه فعالیت در صنعت معدن، برای توسعه بازاریابی و حضور دیجیتال خود، از یک کارشناس خلاق، منظم و مسلط به تولید محتوا و مدیریت شبکه‌های اجتماعی دعوت به همکاری می‌کند.
هدف این موقعیت، تولید و انتشار منظم محتوای کاربردی، تقویت اعتبار تخصصی برند، مدیریت ارتباط با مخاطبان و ایجاد سرنخ‌های واقعی فروش است.
شرح وظایف
• تدوین و اجرای تقویم محتوایی هفتگی و ماهانه با هماهنگی مدیر بازاریابی و متناسب با اهداف تجاری و فعالیت‌های شرکت.
• بررسی مخاطبان هدف، پرسش‌های مشتریان، محتوای رقبا و موضوعات مرتبط با صنعت برای استخراج ایده‌های کاربردی.
• ایده‌پردازی و سناریونویسی برای ریلز، رشته‌استوری، معرفی و مقایسه دستگاه‌ها، محتوای آموزشی، مصاحبه، تجربه مشتری و پوشش پروژه‌ها و نمایشگاه‌ها.
• مشخص‌کردن هدف و مخاطب هر سناریو، شروع جذاب، ترتیب انتقال پیام، متن گوینده یا مجری، تصاویر موردنیاز، نوشته‌های روی تصویر.
• اصلاح و بهبود ایده‌ها و سناریوها براساس بازخورد مدیر مربوطه، امکانات تصویربرداری و نتایج محتواهای قبلی.
• نگارش کپشن، تیتر، متن روی تصویر و متن‌های تبلیغاتی و تخصصی، با حفظ یکپارچگی لحن و هویت بصری برند.
• طراحی پست، استوری و کاور با Canva و تدوین سبک ویدئو با CapCut، InShot، یا ابزارهای مشابه؛ شامل برش، زیرنویس، صداگذاری و آماده‌سازی خروجی مناسب.
• عکاسی و فیلم‌برداری کاربردی با موبایل از دستگاه‌ها، محیط شرکت، تحویل ماشین‌آلات و سایر فعالیت‌ها.
• حضور هماهنگ‌شده در نمایشگاه‌ها، پروژه‌ها و محیط‌های صنعتی برای پوشش محتوایی.

• Experience delivering integrated campaigns across Social Media, Paid Media, Influencer Marketing, and CRM is a plus.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer
Position Overview
We are looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer with more than 6 years of professional software development experience to design, develop, deploy, and maintain modern, scalable, and reliable software applications.
The successful candidate should have strong experience in backend and frontend development, relational databases, scripting, CI/CD, and application deployment. Familiarity with mobile application development, platform architecture, and infrastructure design is also expected.
The role requires the ability to work across the complete software development lifecycle, from understanding requirements and implementing UI/UX designs to backend development, database integration, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
Key Responsibilities
• Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable web-based applications and services.
• Develop and maintain backend services and APIs using technologies such as .NET, Node.js, Go, or equivalent technologies.
• Develop modern, responsive, and maintainable frontend applications.
• Implement UI/UX designs provided by designers, ensuring accuracy, responsiveness, usability, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility.
• Translate business and technical requirements into maintainable software solutions.
• Design and implement RESTful APIs and other appropriate service interfaces.
• Work with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, or equivalent platforms.
• Design database schemas, write and optimize queries, and maintain data integrity and application performance.
• Develop automation and operational scripts using Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages.
• Participate in application architecture and technical design decisions.
• Write clean, modular, reusable, secure, and well-documented code.
• Perform code reviews and contribute to development standards and engineering best practices.
• Develop automated unit, integration, and application tests.
• Troubleshoot and resolve software defects, performance issues, and production incidents.
• Work with source-control and collaborative development platforms such as Git, GitLab, or GitHub.
• Participate in the design and implementation of CI/CD pipelines.
• Support software deployment and release strategies.
• Deploy and operate applications across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
• Collaborate with DevOps, infrastructure, security, UI/UX, QA, product, and business teams.
• Contribute to the design of reliable, scalable, secure, and maintainable application platforms and supporting infrastructure.
• Support integration of web platforms with mobile applications and external systems.
Required Qualifications
Education
• Bachelor's degree (BSc) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or another closely related field.
Professional Experience
• Minimum 6 years of professional software development experience.
• Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining production-grade web applications.
• Strong experience working across both frontend and backend components of software systems.
• Proficiency in at least one backend technology such as .NET, Node.js, Go, or an equivalent technology.
• Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language.
• Proficiency in at least one scripting language such as Bash or Python.
• Experience implementing provided UI/UX designs into responsive and production-ready user interfaces.
• Experience working with at least one relational SQL database such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Microsoft SQL Server.
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and common deployment strategies.
• Familiarity with mobile application development concepts and integration requirements.
• Familiarity with platform architecture and infrastructure design concepts.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
The role
You will own marketing for AHA. The goal is simple: generate a steady flow of qualified inbound leads from our target industries in Australia, New Zealand, the United States and Europe, and support the sales team with the content and campaigns they need to close. You will run the whole marketing function with a modest budget, so you need to be hands-on, commercially minded and able to get results through AI tools and automation rather than headcount.
This role can be full time or part time depending on the candidate. The scope of the role will be adjusted to match the hours agreed.
What you will do
Build and run the marketing plan for AHA, focused on lead generation within our target industries and ideal customer profile.
Produce content for the website, LinkedIn, email and events, including articles, case studies, landing pages, webinars and short video, using AI to draft, edit and repurpose at speed.
Manage marketing automation and nurture journeys in Dynamics 365 Customer Insights and ActiveCampaign, including segmentation, scoring and handover of qualified leads to sales.
Run and optimise paid campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn and Meta, including retargeting, within an agreed monthly budget.
Manage the AHA website on WordPress, including publishing, SEO and conversion improvements.
Improve AHA's visibility in AI search and large language model answers (generative engine optimisation) alongside traditional SEO.
Plan and deliver events such as executive dinners, sponsored events and webinars.
Report on marketing performance in Power BI, including pipeline sourced, cost per lead and campaign return.
Coordinate with the sales team on shared campaigns and brand consistency.
What we are looking for
Three or more years in B2B marketing for software, SaaS or technology solutions.
Experience marketing technology solutions to buyers in the US and European markets, and an understanding of how those buyers research and purchase.
Demonstrated results generating leads for a sales team, not just brand activity.
Strong writing and editing skills in English.
Hands-on with marketing automation, CRM, paid media and web content. You do the work yourself rather than brief an agency.
Comfortable owning a small budget and reporting on return.
Experience marketing to HR, people and culture or executive audiences is an advantage.
AI and tools
AHA runs marketing with AI first. You must have current, practical experience using AI in a marketing role and be able to show what it has produced. You will be expected to use the following from day one:
Claude or similar large language model assistants for content creation, campaign planning, research, copy variants and reporting.
AI features within Google Ads, LinkedIn and Meta for campaign optimisation and creative testing.
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights (marketing) for inbound nurturing, segmentation and lead scoring.
ActiveCampaign for outbound email automation and workflows.
WordPress for website management and publishing.
Power BI for marketing reporting and dashboards.
Microsoft 365, including Teams and Copilot.
AI tools for design, video and audio content such as Canva AI or similar.
How you will be measured
Qualified inbound leads delivered to sales each month.
Pipeline and revenue sourced or influenced by marketing.
Cost per qualified lead and campaign return on spend.
Website traffic, conversion rate and search visibility.
Email engagement and nurture conversion rates.
Employment terms
Employment type: Full time or part time, offshore contractor or employee depending on location
Hours: Flexible. Core overlap with Australian business hours for team and campaign coordination
Remuneration: USD salary commensurate with experience and hours agreed, paid in USD
Location: Remote, offshore
Reports to: CEO, Agile HR Analytics
How to apply
Send your CV and a short four-slide presentation saved as a PDF. We use the slides to see how you think and communicate, so keep them clear and specific. One slide each on:
Your skills and experience: the hard skills and soft skills you bring, with evidence.
Why you want to work with us.
How you would add value to AHA in the first 12 months.
What you expect to get out of this role.
On your skills and experience slide, include two or three examples of marketing work you have produced using AI tools, with a line on the result each one achieved.
Applications without the slide deck will not be considered.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Responsibilities
• Lead and manage the Marketing function and ensure effective implementation of marketing strategies in alignment with the company’s business objectives and overall Pharma Operations strategy.
• Develop annual and strategic marketing plans for assigned pharmaceutical products, including objectives, priorities, target segments, positioning, key messages, and action plans.
• Develop and manage product strategies throughout the product life cycle, from pre-launch and launch to growth, maturity, and optimization.
• Conduct comprehensive market analysis, including market size, growth trends, treatment patterns, customer needs, market dynamics, and business opportunities.
• Conduct competitor analysis covering competing products, pricing, market positioning, competitive advantages, promotional strategies, and market share.
• Develop and execute product launch plans, including launch strategy, positioning, forecasting, promotional plans, cross-functional readiness, and post-launch evaluation.
• Develop and implement integrated marketing and promotional plans across appropriate channels, including scientific, digital, field, event, and other relevant activities.
• Work closely with the Sales and Medical/Scientific teams to translate marketing strategies into effective field execution and maximize commercial impact.
• Monitor product performance and key business indicators, including sales, market share, market growth, ROI, campaign effectiveness, and other relevant KPIs; identify gaps and implement corrective actions.
• Prepare and present periodic management reports and business reviews covering market performance, product performance, marketing activities, opportunities, risks, and recommended actions.
• Identify new market opportunities, unmet market needs, and potential product opportunities and provide recommendations for portfolio expansion and business development.
• Lead branding and brand development activities, including brand positioning, architecture, value proposition, communication strategy, and brand equity development.
• Develop and manage marketing budgets and ensure effective allocation of resources based on business priorities and expected return on investment.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Medical/Scientific, Market Access, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Research & Development, Production, Finance, and other relevant functions to ensure successful execution of product and business plans.
• Lead, coach, and evaluate the Marketing team, establish clear objectives and KPIs, and develop team capabilities.
• Select, brief, manage, and evaluate external marketing agencies, consultants, and service providers to ensure quality, timely delivery, and cost-effectiveness.
• Ensure that all marketing, promotional, communication, and branding activities comply with applicable pharmaceutical laws, regulations, ethical standards, and company policies.
• Report directly to the Vice President of Pharma Operations and provide strategic recommendations on marketing, portfolio, and market development priorities.
• Perform other duties and strategic projects assigned by the Vice President of Pharma Operations.
Required Qualifications & Competencies
• Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical marketing, product management, or a related commercial function.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a managerial or team-lead position, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.
• Master’s degree or PhD in Marketing, Management, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, MBA, or a related field.
• Strong understanding of pharmaceutical marketing, product management, market development, and commercial strategy.
• Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical markets, customer segments, treatment pathways, and industry dynamics.
• Demonstrated ability to develop and execute strategic marketing plans and product strategies.
• Strong capabilities in market research, competitor analysis, market sizing, segmentation, targeting, positioning, and opportunity assessment.
• Strong understanding of product life-cycle management and pharmaceutical product launch excellence.
• Familiarity with branding, brand strategy, customer journey, promotional strategy, and integrated marketing communications.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret sales, market share, market growth, ROI, and marketing KPIs and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with business intelligence or market data tools is an advantage.
• Good knowledge of pharmaceutical advertising, promotional, regulatory, and ethical requirements.
• Strong budget management and resource allocation capabilities.
• Proven ability to lead, develop, and motivate high-performing teams.
• Strong project management, prioritization, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
• Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
